item.title: Characterization of stomata and glandular trichomes of Aloysia citriodora submitted to water stress and seasonal variation
item.description: The objective of this study was to evaluate the stomatal density and glandular trichomes as well as the morphometry of stomata of Aloysia citriodora leaves submitted to different water availability throughout the seasons. item.title: Allelopathic effects of Alternanthera tenella over weeds
item.description: Allelopathy is defined as the interference of one plant in the other through the release of allelochemicals in the environment. This work evaluated the allelopathic influence of Alternanthera tenella on the germination and initial development of Lactuca sativa, Digitaria insularis, Emilia fosbergii and Portulaca oleracea, as well as to quantify and determine the phenolic compounds by High Performance Liquid Chromatography. item.title: First record of the rare orchid Bipinnula polysyka (Orchidaceae: Chloraeinae) for Brazil
item.description: Bipinnula polysyka is herein reported for the first time for the Brazilian Flora. This rare and inconspicuous terrestrial orchid species was previously known from Uruguay and Buenos Aires Province, in Argentina. In the Brazilian State of Rio Grande do Sul, it grows in the open grasslands of the Pampa Biome, which are normally used for cattle grazing.
